Title: Generally Available: vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB integration with Semantic Kernel (.NET)

Body.Content:
It’s now even easier to get started using Azure Cosmos DB for vector search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in your generative AI applications. In vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB, you can use a .NET memory connector for integration with Semantic Kernel.

Learn more.
